system.description: Make a Power Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, spend a Hope to deal d6+1 energy damage using Proficiency. The target makes Reaction Roll 13 or is temporarily Ignited. Ignited targets take 2d6 energy damage at the end of their action. Seal: after successfully using this card, mark a Hit Point to flip it to Release.
